name: Goblin Quality Test
description: A workshop table offers three gadgets, all stamped with a sticker reading 'tested-ish'.

choices.label: Take Common Upgrade
choices.resultText: The gadget only sparkles a normal amount.

choices.label: Test Weird Gadget
choices.description: Gain a rare reward and a random Oopsie.
choices.resultText: The gadget works. The definition of works is flexible.

choices.label: Pay For Safe Version
choices.description: Pay 45 gold for a controlled reward without Oopsie.
choices.resultText: The safe version has only one warning label.
